facts.fact: Le Matin, reporting the 11th MFC Talks, says Morocco has a regulatory framework already well advanced, and that a first phase led by Bank Al-Maghrib laid the regulatory bases, organised interoperability and governed access to infrastructures; no law or rule is named.

Le Matin reports payment institutions (établissements de paiement) and fintechs taking part with banks in Morocco's payments market, with licensed players carrying regulation and compliance for fintechs; no licensing rule is named.
